source: Publisher documentation saved under e3/truth/docs/fresh/ (sha256 in SHA256SUMS): TPC-DS v3.2.0; LDBC SNB specification (v2.2.5-SNAPSHOT, Appendix D for the Interactive v1 legacy data sets); GTFS Schedule Reference; FAA ardata.pdf (5/8/2025); ABS ASGS Edition 3 web pages; SEC Financial Statement Data Sets; College Scorecard Field of Study documentation (October 2026) and data dictionary; EPA AirData FileFormats (v3.0.0); 2024 ACS PUMS data dictionary and Census regions and divisions; City of Chicago portal metadata (ijzp-q8t2, c7ck-438e); USDA FoodData Central download field descriptions (October 2020)
rule: Sigma* is the set of FDs that the publisher documentation implies among the attributes of each relation, projected and closed over the dropped columns, each with a verbatim quote; sure when the quoted text states it (declared key, foreign key to a declared key, an explicit one-to-one or nesting statement), unsure when it needs an inference the text does not spell out. Dependencies the documentation hints at but does not state are listed under undocumented_regularities and are not part of Sigma*. Written from the documentation alone, before any data file was opened.

instance.generator: public data fixed before download for the confirmatory evaluation, joined by fresh.py
instance.construction: College Scorecard 'Most Recent Data by Field of Study' file (release of October 2026, dictionary released October 15, 2026); single table; of its ~245 variables kept the identifiers, descriptions, DISTANCE, the IPEDS counts, the all-student Stafford/Grad PLUS debt counts and medians (ANY and EVAL) with their 10-year payments, the Parent PLUS ANY median and payment, two OPEID6-level earnings metrics at 1 and 4 years and two national 4-year metrics; dropped the remaining debt and earnings disaggregations (Pell, sex), the repayment rates and the other national metrics.

cleaning.missing_values: empty and missing references become '?', kept as a value (null = null)

truth.clause: scorecard_FieldOfStudyDataDocumentation.pdf (Version: October 2026), Defining field of study (p. 1): "The unit of analysis for calculations by field of study is the unique combination of institutional identifiers, a four-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code, and a credential level."; (p. 2): "each field of study is assigned an indicator that describes the availability of distance education programs within that field of study (DISTANCE)"; Number of credentials conferred (p. 2): "Scorecard provides the number of recognized postsecondary credentials conferred by field of study for two consecutive award years (IPEDSCOUNT1 and IPEDSCOUNT2)"
truth.justification: Each row is one field of study, the unique combination of the institutional identifiers (UNITID, OPEID6), the CIP code and the credential level; DISTANCE and the IPEDS counts are values of that field of study. With UNITID -> OPEID6 below, (UNITID, CIPCODE, CREDLEV) is a key too.

audit.quote: "The unit of analysis for calculations by field of study is the unique combination of institutional identifiers, a four-digit Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) code, and a credential level." (Defining field of study, p. 1); "each field of study is assigned an indicator that describes the availability of distance education programs within that field of study (DISTANCE)" (p. 2); "Scorecard provides the number of recognized postsecondary credentials conferred by field of study for two consecutive award years (IPEDSCOUNT1 and IPEDSCOUNT2) as reported by institutions to IPEDS." (p. 2)

truth.clause: scorecard_FieldOfStudyDataDocumentation.pdf (Version: October 2026), Defining field of study (p. 1): "Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) assigned ID number (UNITID) and corresponding institution name (INSTNM), as reported by IPEDS." and "For institutions with multiple UNITIDs (branches) that map to the same six-digit OPEID (main campus)"
truth.justification: INSTNM is the name corresponding to the UNITID, and each UNITID maps to one six-digit OPEID; several UNITIDs may share an OPEID6, so OPEID6 does not determine UNITID.

audit.quote: "Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) assigned ID number (UNITID) and corresponding institution name (INSTNM), as reported by IPEDS." truth.clause: scorecard_FieldOfStudyDataDocumentation.pdf (Version: October 2026), Defining field of study (p. 1): "Scorecard uses this aggregated approach to calculate cumulative debt and post-completion earnings data" and "data calculated at the aggregated OPEID6-level are repeated across any branches that offer those fields of study based on IPEDS Completions component reporting."
truth.justification: Debt (including the monthly payments computed from it) and earnings metrics are calculated per OPEID6, CIP code and credential level and repeated on every branch row: a dependency on a proper subset of the key once UNITID is dropped.

audit.quote: "Scorecard uses this aggregated approach to calculate cumulative debt and post-completion earnings data because not all institutions report information needed to calculate these metrics at the more granular branch location level." (p. 1); "For institutions with multiple UNITIDs (branches) that map to the same six-digit OPEID (main campus), data calculated at the aggregated OPEID6-level are repeated across any branches that offer those fields of study based on IPEDS Completions component reporting." (p. 1); "Scorecard constructs cohorts and calculates data values by field of study using a six-digit OPEID institutional identifier" (OPEIDs, p. 12); "The estimated monthly payment is calculated for all graduates for both types of loans and both methods of debt measurement (DEBT_ALL_PP_ANY_MDN10YRPAY, DEBT_ALL_PP_EVAL_MDN10YRPAY, DEBT_ALL_STGP_ANY_MDN10YRPAY, DEBT_ALL_STGP_EVAL_MDN10YRPAY) and is based on the median cumulative loan debt amortized over 10 years using interest rates available at the time of calculation." (p. 5)

truth.clause: scorecard_FieldOfStudyDataDocumentation.pdf (Version: October 2026), Post-completion earnings (p. 4): "Earnings data within credential level and CIP Code by at the national level were calculated 4, 5, and 7 years after completion." and "are included in the data file (EARN_COUNT_WNE_xYR_NAT, EARN_MDN_xYR_NAT, EARN_P25_xYR_NAT, EARN_P75_xYR_NAT)"
truth.justification: The national metrics are computed once per credential level and CIP code, so every row with that CIP code and credential level carries the same value.

audit.quote: "Earnings data within credential level and CIP Code by at the national level were calculated 4, 5, and 7 years after completion." and "... are included in the data file (EARN_COUNT_WNE_xYR_NAT, EARN_MDN_xYR_NAT, EARN_P25_xYR_NAT, EARN_P75_xYR_NAT)" (Post-completion earnings, p. 4)

truth.clause: scorecard_FieldOfStudyDataDocumentation.pdf (Version: October 2026), Cumulative loan debt (pp. 5-6): "is based on the median cumulative loan debt amortized over 10 years using interest rates available at the time of calculation" and "Academic levels are assigned to credential levels based on the following categorizations:"; (pp. 5-6): "For undergraduate programs, calculations are based on the interest rate at the time of calculation for undergraduate Direct Subsidized Loans" and "For graduate programs, calculations are based on the interest rate at the time of calculation for Direct PLUS Loans for graduate and professional students (9.07%)."
truth.justification: The payment is the median debt amortized at a rate fixed by the academic level, which the credential level determines; unsure because 'based on' and the rounding of the published median leave room for two rows with equal inputs and different payments.
